# ZeroTouch Support

> Independent reviews of customer support, business phone and AI voice software. 52 full reviews live here as the canonical version, 14 of them tested hands-on by us (listed below with the date and what we measured); prices are read on the vendor's page and dated. Last updated 2026-11-09.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

- [Deals](https://zerotouchsupport.com/deals.html): current deals and free trials

## Tested hands-on (14): first-hand findings
We signed up and ran these tools ourselves. The date is the test date; the line is what we measured, not the vendor's claim. All other reviews are researched from the vendor's own pages and buyer reviews, and say so on the page.
- [Landbot](https://zerotouchsupport.com/landbot-review.html): tested 2026-10-31. Measured 2026-10-31: The builder showed fourteen trial days remaining.
- [respond.io](https://zerotouchsupport.com/respond-io-review.html): tested 2026-10-31. Measured 2026-10-31: Growth Trial showed seven days remaining and an end date of November 7.
- [CloudTalk](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloudtalk-review.html): tested 2026-10-24. Measured 2026-10-24: On sign-up day the dashboard showed 'Your demo will EXPIRE in 14 days.' No card was asked.
- [CometChat](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cometchat-review.html): tested 2026-10-23. Measured 2026-10-23: The builder opened without an account on a demo chat (Chats, Calls, Users, Groups) with sample conversations. Customize offers a layout with or without sidebar (default with) and the tabs Conversations,…
- [Typewise](https://zerotouchsupport.com/typewise-review.html): tested 2026-10-23. Measured 2026-10-23: On the day of sign-up, Plan & limits showed 'Trial · 92 days remaining' with no payment method.
- [ZenZap](https://zerotouchsupport.com/zenzap-review.html): tested 2026-10-23. Measured 2026-10-23: Sign-up works only with a mobile number and a six-digit SMS code ('Sign in with email' is for existing users). Onboarding now presents Zenzap as an agent platform: after the workspace it asks who you are…
- [Chatwith](https://zerotouchsupport.com/chatwith-review.html): tested 2026-10-21. Measured 2026-10-21: Onboarding has four steps: Train, Brand, Test and Install. Training sources are a website (with linked pages on the same domain, or a sitemap), files, text or YouTube, against a counter of '0 / 500K…
- [Freshworks](https://zerotouchsupport.com/freshworks-review.html): tested 2026-10-21. Measured 2026-10-21: The sign-up page promised a '14-day all-access free trial'; inside the app the banner said 'your 15-day trial starts today', next to a 'Buy now' button. Our own company domain was accepted without a…
- [Tidio](https://zerotouchsupport.com/tidio-review.html): tested 2026-10-21. Measured 2026-10-21: Sign-up requires a website URL ('Can't be empty!'). Within minutes Tidio read 71 pages of the site we entered into Lyro's knowledge on its own. The source list can delete or set an audience in bulk, but…
- [Help Scout](https://zerotouchsupport.com/help-scout-review.html): tested 2026-10-20. Measured 2026-10-20: Signing up did not start on Free. The account landed on a Plus trial ('Trial Period Oct 20 - Nov 03', 1 user, $54/user, 'First monthly payment on Nov 4, 2026') plus a 92-day AI Answers trial, without…
- [SupportBee](https://zerotouchsupport.com/supportbee-review.html): tested 2026-10-20. Measured 2026-10-20: The '+ Ticket' action is blocked until a mailbox is connected: 'Please connect an email address to create tickets. New tickets can't be created without a connected email address.' Incoming tickets through…

## Reviews (52) — canonical versions
- [800.com Review (2026): From $19/mo, Checked Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/800-com-review.html): 800.com: Startup $19/mo and Small Business $49/mo. The 250-minute cap on Startup (it was 1,000 in August) matters for any real call volume.
- [Aircall Review (2026): From $30/mo, Checked Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/aircall-review.html): Aircall: Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing. 'Unlimited calling' covers listed regions, check yours.
- [Answering Service Care Review (2026): Price & Limits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/answering-service-care-review.html): Answering Service Care: $161, $296 and $575 for the three larger plans. Do the arithmetic before you pick a tier, because their own page does not.
- [AskNest Review (2026): 50 Free AI Replies, Then $4.99/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/asknest-review.html): AskNest: All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial — the free plan is the trial.
- [bOnline Review (2026): UK Business VoIP From £7 a User](https://zerotouchsupport.com/bonline-review.html): bOnline: AI For Business Calls is £19.95, shown against a struck-through £21.95. BOnline does not put its contract length on the pricing page.
- [Calilio Review (2026): $12 a Seat, Calls Meter Apart](https://zerotouchsupport.com/calilio-review.html): Calilio: Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year). The subscription is the platform, not the talking.
- [CallHippo Review (2026): Part Published, Part on Quote](https://zerotouchsupport.com/callhippo-review.html): CallHippo: Read the tab before the number. 'Unlimited calling' is unlimited to the US and Canada: international minutes meter separately.
- [Chatwith Review (2026): AI Agent From $9, Priced in Credits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/chatwith-review.html) (tested hands-on): Chatwith: Starter is $9 a month or $90 a year. The real price depends on credits, and the conversation estimates assume five replies at one credit eac
- [CloudTalk Review (2026): From €19/mo, Tested Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloudtalk-review.html) (tested hands-on): CloudTalk: Lite €19, Starter €25, Essential €29 and Expert €49 per user/mo on annual billing, or €27, €34, €39 and €69 billed monthly.
- [Cloze Review (2026): 25 Free Chats, Then $49/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloze-review.html): Cloze: Free forever with 50 conversations a month, Pro $29 a month and Business $79 a month. The second is the track record, or the absence of one.
- [CometChat Review (Tested): Free to 100 Users, Then $239/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cometchat-review.html) (tested hands-on): CometChat — Billed yearly, shown as a monthly equivalent: at 1,000 MAU Basic is $239 and Advanced $359. The pricing cliff is the honest headline.
- [CrankWheel Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/crankwheel-review.html): CrankWheel: A free plan with no payment details required. If you want an all-purpose meeting platform, this isn't it.
- [EazyChat Review (2026): AI Website Chat From $29.99 per User](https://zerotouchsupport.com/eazychat-review.html): EazyChat charges per user per month. Pricing is per user, so a team of five pays five times the plan price.
- [eDesk Review (2026): From $39/mo, Checked Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/edesk-review.html): eDesk — No free plan: 'Start for free' opens a 14-day full-feature trial with no credit card. The per-agent price is the entry ticket.
- [Fireflies.ai Review (Tested 2026): Free Tier, Then $18/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/fireflies-ai-review.html) (tested hands-on): Fireflies.ai: Free $0 — free forever, unlimited transcription, limited AI summaries, 400 mins of storage per team, 20 AI credits.
- [Freshchat Review (Tested): The Free Plan Covers 10 Agents](https://zerotouchsupport.com/freshchat-review.html) (tested hands-on): Freshchat: Free is $0 for up to 10 agents. The free tier is useful for small teams, but AI features and higher-tier routing sit behind paid plans and 
- [Freshworks Review (Tested): The Pricing Page Has No Prices](https://zerotouchsupport.com/freshworks-review.html) (tested hands-on): Freshworks — On Freshdesk the annual rates are unchanged since 1 August 2026: Growth $19 per agent per month, Pro $55, Enterprise $89, billed annually
- [Gorgias Review (2026): Never Priced Per Agent](https://zerotouchsupport.com/gorgias-review.html): Gorgias: Not priced per agent -- their own line -- but the seats are capped. Never priced per agent is a real advantage, but it starts one tier up.
- [Help Scout Review (2026): Free for 5 Users, Standard $25 a Seat](https://zerotouchsupport.com/help-scout-review.html) (tested hands-on): Help Scout: Standard is $25 per user a month billed annually or $30 monthly, for up to 25 users. The Free plan caps you at 100 contacts a month and on
- [HelpCenter Review (2026): From $40/mo, Checked Nov 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/helpcenter-review.html): HelpCenter: Free to install, and the meter is tickets rather than agents. The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason people stay.
- [Jotform AI Agents Review (Tested): Conversations Are the Cap](https://zerotouchsupport.com/jotform-ai-agents-review.html) (tested hands-on): Jotform AI Agents: Bronze is $34 a month, Silver $39 and Gold $99, each billed annually, with 'save up to 20%' against monthly billing; Enterprise is 
- [Kixie Review (2026): No Seat Price, and Minutes Bill Apart](https://zerotouchsupport.com/kixie-review.html): Kixie: Texts from $0.011 each ($11 per 1,000) on a registered 10DLC number, inbound free. Read the contract term before you sign.
- [KrispCall Review (2026): $12/mo Seats Yearly + Pay-Per-Call](https://zerotouchsupport.com/krispcall-review.html): KrispCall: Advance $32 or $40, up to 50 users. Same honest math as most budget VoIP: the plan buys the platform, the meter buys the conversations.
- [Landbot Review (2026): No-Code Chatbots, Free Plan, Starter €32](https://zerotouchsupport.com/landbot-review.html) (tested hands-on): Landbot: Free is €0 for 100 chats a month, one seat, the full builder and templates. Starter keeps Landbot branding and has no own WhatsApp number.
- [Lucrovox Review (2026): $139 Buys 250 AI Calls a Month](https://zerotouchsupport.com/lucrovox-review.html): Lucrovox: Starter is $139 a month for up to 250 AI-handled calls. The meter is AI-handled calls: Starter’s 250 calls a month is about eight a day.
- [MK Website Assistant Review (2026): AI Enquiry Bot From £39/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/mk-website-assistant-review.html): MK Website Assistant: AI Assistant Plus also costs from £290 and then £59 a month. Prices are "from" amounts, so the final set-up fee can be higher.
- [NeuroAds Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $19/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/neuroads-review.html): NeuroAds: Growth $49 a month or $468 a year (save 20%). Nothing about that is suspicious on its face; new apps have new reviews.
- [Orateur Review (2026): AI Phone Receptionist From CHF 49/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/orateur-review.html): Orateur prices by plan, each with an allowance of AI agent time. The site is in French only and prices are in Swiss francs.
- [Pylon Review (2026): Enterprise Needs Seven Seats](https://zerotouchsupport.com/pylon-review.html): Pylon no longer publishes rates. The per-seat sticker is the entry ticket; the AI that makes the platform sing is metered separately.
- [Quo Review (2026): Telecom Taxes in 16 States](https://zerotouchsupport.com/quo-review.html): Quo — (2026) Three tiers: Starter $15/user/mo annual (billed $180/yr) or $19 monthly. Call reliability is the recurring complaint.
- [Readymode Review (2026): iQ Halves the Cost Per Number](https://zerotouchsupport.com/readymode-review.html): Readymode: Starter $239 billed monthly or $199 billed annually, for 1+ licenses. The per-seat price is premium, and the model rewards scale.
- [respond.io Review (2026): From $79/mo, Tested Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/respond-io-review.html) (tested hands-on): respond.io — Four tiers, billed on monthly active contacts rather than seats: Starter $79/month, Growth $159, Advanced $279, and Enterprise on quote.
- [Ruby Review (2026): Real Pricing, Real Limits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/ruby-review.html): Ruby: $5.00 a minute at the bottom, $3.45 at the top. You're paying premium rates for real human receptionists billed per minute.
- [Salesmsg Review (2026): Calls Eat the Text Credits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/salesmessage-review.html): Salesmsg — Monthly billing: Basic is $25 a month for 500 credits a month; Pro is $329 a month for 10,000 credits a month. Size the credits, not the he
- [Signal House Review (2026): 500 Numbers Cost Less Than 499](https://zerotouchsupport.com/signal-house-review.html): Signal House: $0.0050 from 500k segments a month, $0.0045 from 1m, $0.0040 from 2m, $0.0035 from 5m and $0.0030 from 10m. Take the entry rate with no 
- [SimpleTexting Review (2026): $29/mo Plus $10 for the Number](https://zerotouchsupport.com/simpletexting-review.html): SimpleTexting: The credit plans themselves are $29 (500 credits), $49 (1,000), $79 (2,000), $109 (3,000), $229 (7,500), $399 (15,000).
- [StoreFAQ Review (2026): Success Costs You Page Views](https://zerotouchsupport.com/storefaq-review.html): StoreFAQ: Enterprise $49.99 a month or $479.90 a year, a 20% saving. The meter is FAQ page views, and that is the thing this app exists to increase.
- [SupportBee Review (2026): From $20/mo, Tested Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/supportbee-review.html) (tested hands-on): SupportBee: Month to month, Startup is $20/seat/month and Enterprise is $25/seat/month. Enterprise is listed as everything in Startup plus five named 
- [SupportYourApp Review (2026): Outsourced Support From $1,200/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/supportyourapp-review.html): SupportYourApp does not publish prices. No prices are published, only a starting point given in a partner message and described as under review.
- [Textline Review (2026): Backup Credits Cost 33% More](https://zerotouchsupport.com/textline-review.html): Textline: Add-on message credits $0.03 each, bought in advance; backup message credits $0.04 each. Two costs are easy to miss and both are monthly.
- [Tidio Review (Tested Oct 2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/tidio-review.html) (tested hands-on): Tidio: The free plan carries 50 billable conversations, 100 Flows visitors reached and 50 Lyro AI conversations.
- [Tossable Digits Review (2026): Virtual Phone Numbers From $7/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/tossable-digits-review.html): Tossable Digits: Extra US or Canada numbers cost $3.49, $2.99, $2.19 or $1.49 a month and extra minutes $0.12, $0.10. Annual plans get no pro-rated re
- [Trackr Review (2026): From $10/mo, Checked Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/trackr-review.html): Trackr: Four tiers and no free plan, billed in USD every 30 days through Shopify. The rating is 4.1 over 56 reviews on 12 September 2026.
- [Typewise Review (Tested): From $99/mo Plus $1-2 a Resolution](https://zerotouchsupport.com/typewise-review.html) (tested hands-on): Typewise: Starter is $99 a month or $999 a year with 1 user, email and chat. The bill has two parts and both are published.
- [UniTel Voice Review (2026): Extra Users Cost $9.99](https://zerotouchsupport.com/unitel-voice-review.html): UniTel Voice: Solo $9.99/mo, Team $19.99/mo and Office $29.99/mo, each with one toll-free or local number and unlimited calling and texting.
- [Vanity Number Review (2026): One-Time Fee From $99.99, No Refunds](https://zerotouchsupport.com/vanity-number-review.html): Vanity Number: The catalogue is browsable by price band, from under $250 through $251 to $500, $501 to $1,000. You are buying the number only.
- [Vida AI Review (2026): AI Phone Agents From $250 a Month](https://zerotouchsupport.com/vida-ai-review.html): Vida AI: Starter is $250 a month with 1 agent and no included usage. Business allowances do not roll over, and the terms rule out refunds.
- [Voye Review (2026): Yearly Billing Saves up to 20% on Bundles](https://zerotouchsupport.com/voye-review.html): Voye: $9.99 for 5 GB, $19.99 for 12 GB, $39.99 for 30 GB, $69.99 for 55 GB, $119.99 for 100 GB. ESIM data pooling beats classic roaming for traveling 
- [Wati Review (2026): From €59/mo, Checked Sep 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/wati-review.html): Wati: Growth €59/mo, Pro €119/mo and Business €279/mo billed annually, or €69, €149 and €349 billed monthly. The plan price is the smallest part of th
- [Weave Review (2026): From $199 a Month, $149 Bundles](https://zerotouchsupport.com/weave-review.html): Weave's plans page (getweave.com/plans, read 13 October 2026) is now a configurator: the base plan starts at $199 a month.
- [Zendesk Review (2026): Copilot Needs the $115 Tier](https://zerotouchsupport.com/zendesk-review.html): Zendesk — Per agent per month on annual billing, US storefront: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115. The prices shown are annual
- [ZenZap Review (Tested Oct 2026): Flat Packages Replace Seats](https://zerotouchsupport.com/zenzap-review.html) (tested hands-on): ZenZap: The per-seat prices are gone. The pricing undercuts Slack: the honest question is ecosystem: team chat lives or dies on integrations and habit
